notes: 16 real prints from 16 different slugs (no memes, owner posts or old-UI HUD), tagged 'prints reais de clientes diferentes' (lowercase so it stays inside x≤880). Tiles are square cover-crops of the safe files; redaction pills are untouched (some are partly outside a tile, never made to look like text). After review (clarity was ~7 because tiles are illegible), render 2 swaps the title to 'shiny, boss e loot / NO AFK.' when the grid completes, describing what the prints show; the hook title returns for the loop. The mascot 'carve' uses the official logo's alpha as a CSS mask, then crossfades to the logo with the eye glow (end card). Rubric (render 2): hook 8, re-hooks 8, clarity 8, craft 8, truth 9, sound 8, brand 9, CTA 8, loop 9, distinct 8 = 8.3.
